excluded_features.name: PageValues
excluded_features.explanation: PageValues is computed by the analytics source from the average value of pages visited prior to completing a transaction, making it derived from transaction/conversion outcomes rather than observable independently at decision time. Excluded from the primary deployment-safe model per PROJECT_BLUEPRINT.md Section 4.4 and decision D06. May be used only in a separate, explicitly labeled sensitivity analysis, never in the deployment-safe model or the agent/automation path.

notes: See docs/leakage-audit.md for the full per-feature availability review.
